name: Northgate Bedroom Studio
description: Bedroom specialist. Mid-range shop: fair market prices. We carry bed frames, nightstands, wardrobes, mirrors.
skill_description: We sell bed frames, nightstands, wardrobes, mirrors, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
